content: Magtarr khur mua oo nʉʉ aawai Ẽwandam chog dewamta ʉ̈gtharmua bëem oojim. Mag simʉn ĩchab chi jua thierr aawai nem iek theeg sĩejim. Mag pierrwai jẽbën sĩita araraa aadëjim, i mor gaaimua.

content.text: “¡Ya Babilonia phöbörön eegar pajim!
Ĩsin ya sĩi pabʉ̈ ee sĩerrjëem khʉʉn diiu;
mepeen khaigbam khĩirpierr naajem di anaa pabʉ̈ eem nem maach khoojem khʉʉn diigta pabaadëbahab” a sĩejim.
“Warran iin chadcha jãg ich parhooba deeum gaaijã pʉrpʉr sĩerrarr gaaimua durrpierram khʉʉnta nag dënjö thumaa khëch wai sim dʉ̈i ichig paa wai sĩejim.
Reinaanagjã amach ʉʉi dʉ̈ímjö ich dʉ̈ita khapes apiwi,
nem jua paraam khʉʉnagjã sĩi mag ag ee nem parhooba amachdëu khõchagpierr nem waupi sim gaaimua warag phatkhon paraam khʉʉnag paapʉ̈ijim.
Mamʉ ich paarmua maagjerrta ĩsin jũrr ichta eegar pabaadëm” a jaaumajim.

content: Mag chi Ẽwandam chog iekha öbaadëm ee, deeu ʉ̈gtharmua woun iekjö,

content.text: “Pãar mʉ chaainkha nʉm khʉʉn, jãg phöbör eemua öbërwi chawag ërëubaadët” ajim.
“Magbamʉn pãachpa dʉ̈i amau pekau wau nʉm ee burrwi paai öbërbaadeewai, pãachpata phithurg ee mawi dau aug wauju.
Jãg phöbörön sĩi pekau pöoma simgui” ajim.
“I pekau pömagan sĩi ʉ̈gthaa edjã ee sĩmii wëjömjö sim.
Maagwai jãg nem khaigbam parhooba ichdëu waum aig wau sim gaaimua, mua i gaai jua khʉaba deejugui” ajim ich Ẽwandamau.
“Ichdëu chikham dʉ̈i aajerrjö abat” ajim, “jũrr i dʉ̈i.
Ichdëu nem khaigba waaujerr ʉ̈r jũrr ag khãai atcha biek numí i gaai deebat.
Ichdëu chikhamnag döpiejerr khãaijã jũrr athuucha nem achag waaurëu deebat.
Jãg ichdëupai ich thöwi parhooba ichdëu khõchagpierr aajerr paar, ich agjö i gaai mas waunaa i dau aug waupibat” ajim.
“Iruan ichdëupai ich igwi, ‘Mʉʉn mʉiguin rey ʉʉijöta ʉm, mʉ chan khoopaa ʉʉi khabam; mʉg ʉrrʉm chan mʉ chan bʉ̈ʉrjã dau aphʉʉ ʉrrabaju’ a iekhaajem.
Mamʉ mua mag chirʉmgui” ajim ich Ẽwandamau:
“Ich jãg ʉrrʉm paar i ed bëeju paar sim.
Mag ed, khãai ãbpaim ee i gaai mas aju. Mua i gaai nem khaigbam khĩir pogkhe chachmamua, õor pöm öpiwia, jãdau theegjã burrpijugui” ajim.
“Mʉch pãar Pör chi jua thierrauchata mag i dau aphʉʉ api chiraawai,
wajap i dauhi ãrpiwi,
ãbmiecha paawai chi phöbörjã thum sĩi örpʉ̈ijugui” ajim ich Ẽwandamaucha.

content: Mag phöbör örbapäaiwai, reinaan ag ee amach ʉʉin dʉ̈ímjö khapes awi parhooba amachdëu ampierr arr khʉʉnau ʉ̈apëpërkhamua, i athee bĩeju anaabá, chi naar appai ʉ̈gthaa edjã ee jĩu thʉnʉm oowia.
Mag oowia dëgölp amach gaaijã agjö aju khĩirjuwi, aigjã bëeba, warp amach nʉm aarpaimua,

content.text: “¡Ë! ¡Aay, Babilonia!
Phöbör pöomanaa chi jua thierr arrta ĩs chad pʉ chan at oobam.
Sĩi sëukhabarmjö abarm ee pʉ gayan Ẽwandamau masta deebarmgui” aju jũrram khʉʉnau.

content: Ĩchab nem jua paraam khʉʉnaujã amach daúa phöbör magbarm oobaawai, bĩe nʉmua ʉ̈apëpër aju anʉm, amachdëu oowai ya tag amach nem për auju khʉʉn chukhu aphöbaadëm khĩirjuwia.

Jãgbaawai, nem inag pöm waibëewiajã, “¿Khaíu për athaju? Mʉig për aaujeejim: phĩr, phatkhon, mokdau parhẽpagkham, perlas; put wajapham lino dën seda dën dʉ̈i sĩi phuriinaa khichphë khĩirkha sĩsidʉm; pa thũpham khĩirpierr; marfil dën nem wau sĩsidʉm, pa wajapham dën, jierr dën, cobre dën maimua mármol dën nem wau sĩsidʉm.”

Maimua amach wir aigpai, “¿Khaíu athajugui?” aju, “thũpag pöm phëbëe nʉm, canelajöm, incienso, mirra, jʉ̈gdee; vino, nemkhau, arin, trigo; nemchaain daphʉm nem uajem, cabaai, oveja, carro, maimua par phidkhamkhĩir õor për nʉmjã, ¿khaíuta jãgʉm nem thum awaagáwa?” aju, amach ödegpai.

content.text: “Nemjõ sĩphamjö pua ʉ̈rcha pii aajerr ya ĩs chan tag chukhu aadëmgui” aju.
“Pʉ nem ooimʉ sĩsid arrjã thum phatkhonpa ĩsin ya pua okhoom iekchata okhoobapʉ̈im.
Jãgbarm chan pua tag oog khabamgui” aju, mag chi phöbör uu thʉnʉmʉgta.

content: Maimua jũrr nem jua paraam khʉʉn magʉm thum për nʉmua mag phöbör gaaimua warag phatkhon paraamʉg patarr khʉʉnaujã amachdëu mag oobaawai, ĩchab amach gaaijã agjö aju khĩirjuwia, aigjã bëeba, warp amach nʉm aarpaimuata bĩenaa ʉ̈apëpërkhamua,

content.text: “¡Ë! ¡Aay, phöbör pöoma eegar pajim!” aju.
“Pʉʉn chadcha phöbör ooimʉganaa, sĩi ʉʉi khajũa wajapham lino dën jũanaa, khĩirpierr chi phurjã jũanaa, khichphë khĩirjã jũa simjöta sĩejim.
Mag jũanaa chihöo phĩr dën, perlas, maimua mokdau parhẽpagkhampa jũa simjö sĩerrta,
jöpcha sĩi sëukha nʉmjö arr ee phatkhon pöoma okhoobarmgui” aju.

content: Magbaawai agjö barco eem capitannaan, marinernaan maimua thum ar döjãrr jörrjëemuata phatkhon khĩirdamjö oojem khʉʉnjã thum warppai nʉisiju anaabá.
Mam warppaimua mag phöbör uurdʉ thʉnʉm naar edjã ee phʉis jĩu thʉnʉm oowia, thet ääakhamua, “¿Jamta deeum phöbör ich mʉgjökham maadëu oog agá?” aju anʉm.
Magnaa chadcha amach gaai masi nʉm õrag oomkhĩir, amach pör ee jẽb phöpʉ̈inaa ʉ̈apëpërkham dʉ̈i bĩe nʉmua,

content.text: “¡Ë! ¡Aay, phöbör pöoma khitarr!
Maar thum phũas ee barco paraam khʉʉn, pʉ gaaimuata chadcha maar riknaanag paaukhajimgui” aju.
“Magtarrta jöpcha arr ee pʉʉn warreta eegar pabaadëmgui” aju.
Mamʉ warm khʉʉn mag bĩephöo thʉnʉm daar, ʉ̈gtharm magwe onee abat.
Onee abat ĩchab Ẽwandam chaain, Ẽwandam i jaaumien, maimua ich i jaaumkhĩir ichdëucha jʉr autarr khʉʉnjã agjö onee abat.
Ẽwandamau Babiloniapien dʉ̈i jãgbarmua, jũrr pãarta irua dau ee aug khaugwi am gaaita mas dee sim khabahab, amachdëu pãach dʉ̈i aajerrjö.

content: Magbaawai ãb Ẽwandam chog ĩchab nem jua theega simua, mok pör pöoma sim phũas ee barpʉ̈inaa magjim:

content.text: “Babilonia, phöbör pömaam, pʉʉn cha mua mok barbapʉ̈imjöta buudimamgui” ajim.
“Jãgbarm chan mʉg atag pawiajã, pʉ kaaijã ee chan bʉ̈ʉrjã tag arpa sir nʉm iek ũrba, karris iekjã ũrba, ni trompeta iekjã ũrbam.
Nem inag wau nʉm gaai phidkha nʉm khʉʉnjã chukhu, ni mok bã nʉm iek jʉjʉrrkhamjã tag ũrbamgui” ajim.
“Pʉʉta jãgbarm chan mʉg atag pawiajã pʉ ee õtdaudam phuu dʉnʉmjã ooba, ni õor jua pʉʉrwai onee serereu aajerr iekjã ũrbam.
Pʉ eem nem jua paraam khʉʉnan, chadcha mʉg durr gaai chi jua thierrnaan ajim.
Maimua pʉchdëujã pua durrpierram khʉʉn sĩi khũgur wai sĩejim, pʉchdëu nem khaigba wau simta õrau khaugbam gaaimua.
Pari mag sĩerrta, ya pʉʉn chadchata eegar pabaadëmgui” ajim.

content: Magta chadcha Babilonia phöbör eegar paju. Mamʉ mag i eegar pajuun, ag eeta Ẽwandam chaain bag ãrtarr pöoma thʉnʉm gaaimuau. Aigta thʉnʉm: Ẽwandam i jaaumien dʉ̈i thum i chaain bag ãrmatarr, maimua thum ar i gaaimua durrpierr chikhamnau juau thõopʉ̈imarr khʉʉn bagjã agjö.
